# react-pts-canvas

> A typed React 18.2/19 component that owns a Pts CanvasSpace and connects Pts
> drawing, input, players, and disposal to React lifecycle.

Canonical documentation:

- [README](https://github.com/williamngan/react-pts-canvas/blob/master/README.md): installation, common workflows, React Server Component usage, repository setup, and validation commands
- [API reference](https://github.com/williamngan/react-pts-canvas/blob/master/API.md): every public prop, default, callback, exported type, precedence rule, and lifecycle transition
- [Migration guide](https://github.com/williamngan/react-pts-canvas/blob/master/MIGRATION.md): upgrading from npm 0.5.2 to 1.0.0 and deprecated-prop replacements
- [Changelog](https://github.com/williamngan/react-pts-canvas/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Pts guide](https://ptsjs.org/guide/): the underlying Pts drawing and Space model

Core package facts:

- Runtime export: `PtsCanvas`.
- Primary types: `PtsCanvasProps`, `PtsCanvasImperative`, callback types,
  `PtsCanvasInputOptions`, `ActionType`, and error context/phase types.
- Peer dependencies: Pts `^1.0.0`, React `^18.2.0` or React 19, and matching
  React DOM. Upgrading from 0.5.2 also requires upgrading Pts from 0.12 to 1.0.
- Entries: ESM and CommonJS with TypeScript declarations and a preserved
  `"use client"` directive.
- DOM: one wrapper `div` containing one `canvas`; size the wrapper explicitly.
- Defaults: background `#9ab`; resize, retina, play, refresh, pointer, and touch
  enabled; offscreen buffer, keyboard, visibility pauses, and frame throttling
  disabled.
- Live updates: callbacks, background, resize, input, playback, refresh,
  min-frame time, visibility controls, players, and tempo.
- Space replacement: `retina`, Pts `offscreen`, or effective pixel-density
  changes.
- Cleanup order: function returned by `onReady`, then `onDispose`, then input
  teardown and `CanvasSpace.dispose()`.
- Input caveat: Pts does not update the pointer or dispatch actions while the
  space is stopped; `play={false}` also suspends `onAction`.
- RSC caveat: the package is a Client Component boundary, but drawing callbacks
  must originate in a consumer module marked `"use client"`.
- Ownership: consumers may inspect the imperative space/form/player but must not
  dispose the space or mutate the internal callback player.

Repository status:

- `src/index.tsx` and `API.md` are the runtime and prose sources of truth.
- `dist/` is generated. Run `pnpm check` for complete validation.
